title: wpr-education district schools data file
description: Shape of data/schools/{dpi_code}.json: the district-file metrics per school. schools -> school code (DPI SCHOOL_CODE) -> {name, type, topics}; topics -> topic id -> school year -> metric -> cell. name/type come from the school's most recent row (names drift across years). type is DPI's GRADE_GROUP school-type label (Elementary School, Middle School, High School, Combined Elementary/Secondary School, ...). Cells with value null must have suppressed true and vice versa — enforced in pipeline/validate.py.
